note: Every dollar this studio has spent, one record per paid generation run. Harold Kim (Finance) backfilled these entries on 2026-09-03 from the figures written in CREDITS.md, and each entry names the CREDITS.md lines it came from; from here the art pipeline appends its own record on every paid call via tools/record_spend.py, so CREDITS.md keeps the provenance and this file keeps the money. Records only: this file holds no totals and implies no balance — anything summed or carried forward is the reader's arithmetic, not stored here. Read the fields this way. balance_after is the balance the vendor reported after that run and is null wherever nobody wrote one down, and reconciled is true only where such a balance exists, so the unreconciled tail is visible rather than smoothed over. dollars is null where CREDITS.md records that a run happened but never recorded its cost; an unpriced run is a record, not an omission, and it makes any lifetime total a floor rather than a figure. kind is 'generation' for a paid vendor call and 'derived' for an asset built locally from art already bought, which CREDITS.md records at $0.00 and which is kept here so this ledger is complete against its source. No purchase of vendor credits is recorded anywhere in CREDITS.md, so these entries are consumption, not the cash that funded it.
